x: The usual 2 miles Walk handicap gave a win to a newcomer D. Russell (570yds) in 14m.31s. and he promises to augment our team strength in a very short while. 2nd and 3rd were Joe Coleman (440 yds) and George Oliver (320 yds).

Other positions were Ted Smith 10th, Ray Switzer 18th, Harry Shields 21st Bob Readman 22nd, D. Russell 27th, Nick Milsum 28th, Wally Emery 29th and veteran Bert East 34th, totalling 11 of the 39 finishers.
For his effort he easily won the handicap off 1.45 with D. McMullen 2nd and D.
Fastest: 1 M Ashton (Aldershot F&D) 16:34; 2 D Russell (Shaftesbury B) 17:53; 3 B Hope (Woodford GwEL) 17:54; 4 T Ellacott ('A') 18:00; 22 M Whiting ('B') 19:45.
